item.content:encoded:
Aaaand there's not enough here for me. The bit about Bintanath killing Ramesses was a nice surprise, but not enough to carry the whole piece. A rather large chunk of the item history, and thus the piece itself, is mostly devoted to tracing the political history of Egypt, and then suddenly the item history stops at MC&D's acquisition? Isn't their whole gimmick that they sell or rent things out? Aren't there any records of that?

The temple priests keep popping up over and over, but they seem to be pretty extraneous to the story. Moreover, the one thing I ended up wanting to know is that why is there a Nilometer that you can use to restore your health by drowning a loved one? There are some pieces that can just be about a weird unexplainable thing happening and how it shapes people's lives, but this doesn't have nearly as pronounced an effect in-text as you'd want from something like that.
